query:
select clock_timestamp() as observed_at,
(select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as installed_migrations,
(select count(*) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='api') as api_functions,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('proname',p.proname,'oid',p.oid,'definition_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'body_lf_sha256',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(replace(p.prosrc,E'\r\n',E'\n'),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'configuration',p.proconfig,'preserved_metadata',to_jsonb(p)-'prosrc') order by p.proname) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='api' and p.proname in ('wave5_cash_date_command','wave5_cash_save_v2')) as repaired_routines,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('jobid',jobid,'active',active) order by jobid) from cron.job where jobid in (4,5,6)) as reviewed_schedule_state
